title: Principal Price Realization Strategy Manager
description:
Who we are 

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! 

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. 
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Principal Price Realization Strategy Manager

About the job

This is a high-impact role, critical to driving Twilio's pricing strategy and developing key pricing strategic decisions. Your work will directly contribute to accelerating Twilio's business growth while simplifying the purchasing experience for our customers.

As the Principal Price Realization Strategy Manager, you will drive the pricing strategy, analytics, and operational execution for our digital and product monetization initiatives. Reporting directly to the Director of Price Realization Strategy, you will serve as a strategic leader responsible for shaping global pricing and discounting frameworks, build and design executive-facing dashboards, and optimizing revenue performance across our entire product portfolio.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Shape & Drive Pricing Strategy: Architect and execute price optimization models that accelerate business performance. You will blend price elasticity, competitive differentiation, and deep financial analysis into actionable monetization frameworks.
  • Lead PLG & Self-Service Monetization: Partner directly with Growth Marketing, Self-service Sales, Console Engineering, and Finance teams to align on product-led growth (PLG) strategies, ensuring seamless pricing execution across digital touchpoints.
  • Analytics Design: Own the design, optimization, and scaling of advanced pricing analytics dashboards (Tableau/Looker) and operational workflows. Turn complex data infrastructure into strategic tools that enhance efficiency and maximize profitability.
  • Deliver Deep-Dive Data Insights: Query and analyze complex datasets across sales, customer behavior, product usage, and financials to uncover hidden revenue opportunities, pressure-test hypotheses, and scale high-impact strategies.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Act as a critical bridge and internal champion across GTM Strategy, Product, Sales, Marketing, and Finance to ensure organizational alignment and flawless execution of new pricing initiatives.

Qualifications 

Not all applicants will have skills that match a job description exactly. Twilio values diverse experiences in other industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. While having “desired” qualifications make for a strong candidate, we encourage applicants with alternative experiences to also apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required: 

  • Pricing Expertise: 8+ years of relevant experience, including 5+ years of direct ownership over consumption-based pricing and monetization strategies within IaaS, PaaS, or developer-focused B2C/Product-led growth ecosystems.
  • Financial Modeling & Analytics: Hands-on mastery of developing complex pricing models and monetization frameworks, combined with 3+ years of experience building analytics dashboards in Tableau or Looker to drive strategic, revenue-optimizing decisions.
  • Cross-Functional Project Management: A proven track record of leading and delivering complex, multi-stakeholder projects that generate clear, measurable business impact.
  • Executive Communication & Influence: Exceptional oral and written communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to translate complex pricing concepts into compelling narratives that influence peers and senior leadership.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative or business-related field. 

Desired:

  • Platform-Level Pricing Strategy: Direct experience designing and scaling multi-product, platform-level pricing strategies tailored to developer-focused B2C/Product-led growth ecosystems.
  • Advanced Data Visualization: Proven experience designing and operationalizing clear, intuitive dashboards in Tableau or Looker to translate dense data into actionable, executive-facing insights.
  • Global Pricing & Localization: Familiarity with navigating regional pricing dynamics, including multi-currency strategies, local market nuances, and regulatory constraints.
  • Advanced Education: Consulting experience, MBA or an advanced degree in a highly quantitative discipline.

Location: 

This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, NJ, NY, PA, WA.

Travel 

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

*Please note this role is open to candidates outside of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State. The information below is provided for candidates hired in those locations only.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

  • Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $141,520.00 - $176,900.00
  • Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $149,840.00 - $187,300.00 
  • Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $166,400.00 - $208,000.00
  • This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until Oct1st, but may change based on business needs. 

 

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

About the job

This position is needed to maintain, optimize, and scale extraordinary partner portal infrastructure for our rapidly growing Global Partnerships teams. The Partner Support team is essential for the success and scalability of our partner and indirect sales channels. We are the system heart of the organization, driving the platform configurations, integrations, and data hygiene that unlock new possibilities across Channel Sales, Alliances, and Partner Marketing.

This Senior Impartner Platform Administrator will serve as the technical owner of our partner ecosystem tech stack. With a strong focus on advanced Impartner PRM configuration and robust Salesforce CRM integration, you will execute our technical roadmap to deliver frictionless user experiences for our global partners. This role is a perfect match for a technical platform administrator who thrives on deep system architecture, automated workflows, and high-impact "Keep the Lights On" (KTLO) system maintenance.

The ideal candidate has a passion for building robust integrations, possesses an eye for system data integrity, and is constantly seeking ways to simplify complex admin configurations behind the scenes.

Responsibilities

  • Own Platform Administration: Manage day-to-day technical operations of the Impartner PRM platform, including access controls, page layouts, content management, and localized portal branding.
  • Maintain the CRM Sync: Configure, monitor, and troubleshoot the critical data sync between Impartner and Salesforce.com, ensuring leads, accounts, and custom deal registration data flow accurately across both systems.
  • Build Automated Workflows: Develop code-free automated partner lifecycles utilizing Impartner’s Journey Builder, setting up milestone alerts, automated tier progressions, and customized onboarding tracks.
  • Support Channel Enablement: Architect and maintain partner competency programs, training modules, and certification pathways within the portal to keep our global partners enabled.
  • Manage Lead & Deal Flow: Oversee the mechanics of lead distribution algorithms, deal registration routing, and Market Development Funds (MDF) application/claim workflows.
  • Enforce Platform Governance: Audit system logs, data health, and security rules. Ensure compliance with corporate data protection standards and platform updates across both Impartner and Salesforce environments.
  • Drive UAT and Testing: Conduct technical vetting, build out testing protocols in sandbox environments, and execute error-free production deployments for new tool integrations or module releases.

  • Compulsory Salesforce Certification: Must hold a current Salesforce Certified Administrator credential (Advanced Administrator or Platform App Builder is highly desired).
  • Impartner Platform Credentials: Active participation in/completion of Impartner’s technical training and product administrator alignment programs (such as Impartner Certified Administrator pathways).
  • Technical Integration Skills: A proven track record managing complex API syncs, mapping custom fields between PRMs and Salesforce, and resolving sync log exceptions.
  • Problem Solving & Analytics: Strong experience building advanced operational dashboards, custom reports, and auditing data integrity across integrated systems.
  • Stakeholder Execution: Demonstrated success managing project timelines, organizing technical backlogs, and translating GTM business logic into solid system configurations.

Desired:

  • Advanced Toolkit: Experience utilizing backlog and documentation tools like Jira and Confluence to manage configuration requests.
  • Developer Familiarity: Basic understanding of HTML/CSS for portal layout styling or specialized workflow scripts is a plus.
  • Other Systems: experience with Cloud Coach and Professional Services workflow is a plus
  • Global Support Experience: Experience managing multi-currency, localized, or multi-lingual partner portals for a global channel ecosystem.

description: CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy. About the Role Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including: Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands Skincare and beauty Tech and software Finance and investing Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability Education Home improvement Automobiles and motorcycles Health and wellness Medical and clinical fields Digital marketing SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.

title: Senior Communications Specialist (1-Year Contract - Fixed Term)
description:
Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.

We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.

About the team

The Communications team at Careem plays a pivotal role in shaping the brand narrative and reputation across the region, both externally and within the organisation. We work cross-functionally with leadership, business verticals, and stakeholders to develop and deliver compelling stories that reflect our purpose of simplifying lives and building an awesome organisation. Based in Dubai, this role sits within the Communications function, serving as a key voice for Careem across earned and owned media channels as well as internal channels that keep colleagues informed, engaged, and inspired.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Communications Specialist to join our Communications team in Dubai. This role spans both external and internal communications. Externally, you will help craft and execute strategic communication initiatives that support Careem's business objectives across its services, including ride-hailing, food delivery, payments, and quick commerce. This covers developing external narratives, managing media relations, and building brand affinity in priority markets. Internally, you will help shape how Careem communicates with its colleagues, supporting leadership communications, all-hands moments, and campaigns that bring our purpose and priorities to life across the organisation.

What you’ll do

  • Execute external and internal communications strategies that amplify Careem’s mission, services, and impact
  • Manage media relations including press outreach, press release drafting, and maintaining strong relationships with journalists and influencers across priority markets
  • Support internal communications, including leadership emails, all-hands content, org announcements, and campaigns that keep colleagues informed and engaged
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders (Product, Marketing, Policy, People, etc.) to align messaging and ensure consistent communication across external and internal channels
  • Handle crisis communication and reputation management in partnership with senior leadership
  • Track media coverage and internal engagement, creating regular reporting to assess effectiveness and guide improvements
  • Support executive visibility through media interviews, speaking opportunities, authored content, and internal leadership moments

What you’ll need

  • 5-7 years of experience in communications, public relations, or journalism, preferably within a high-growth tech company or leading PR agency
  • Proven experience developing and executing strategic communications plans across multiple markets
  • Strong writing, storytelling, and editorial skills with an ability to translate complex topics into compelling narratives
  • Excellent media network and relationship management skills, particularly in the MENA region
  • Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment with a proactive and solutions-oriented mindset
  • Fluency in both English and Arabic is required

Additional Details:

  • Based in Dubai, reporting into the Communications function 
  • Collaborating with teams across the Careem platform in the UAE, KSA, Egypt, Pakistan, and Jordan
  • This is a 1-year, fixed-term contract position with the possibility of extension based on performance and business needs.

What we’ll provide you

We offer colleagues the opportunity to drive impact in the region while they learn and grow. As a full time Careem colleague, you will be able to:

  • Work and learn from great minds by joining a community of inspiring colleagues.
  • Put your passion to work in a purposeful organisation dedicated to creating impact in a region with a lot of untapped potential.
  • Explore new opportunities to learn and grow every day.
  • Work remotely from any country in the world for 30 days a year with unlimited vacation days per year.
  • Access to healthcare benefits and fitness reimbursements for health activities including gym, health club, and training classes.

title: Junior Category Executive
description:
Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.

We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.

About the Team

The Careem Groceries team is transforming the way people shop for everyday essentials by offering a fast, reliable, and seamless Q-commerce experience. Within this fast-paced environment, the Category Management team is responsible for building the right assortment, pricing, and promotions that delight customers while driving business growth.

About the Role

As a Junior Category Executive, you will be the analytical engine of the category team - turning large volumes of commercial data into clear insights, dashboards, and presentations that shape decisions with suppliers and senior management. This role is ideal for someone who is highly analytical, comfortable with SQL and data tools, and eager to build a career in category management within a fast-paced Q-commerce environment.

What You'll Do

  • Analyse large volumes of category, supplier, and customer data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities – and translate them into clear insights and actionable next steps.
  • Write and maintain queries on Insights and in SQL to extract, validate, and manipulate data for category and commercial analysis.
  • Automate recurring data reports and build dashboards to enable day-on-day monitoring of sales, pricing, margins, and stock availability.
  • Design easy-to-use, self-serve dashboards that allow the category team and stakeholders to track performance without manual effort.
  • Create creative, well-structured decks and presentations - both ad-hoc and on a regular cadence - for external supplier performance reviews and senior management meetings, showcasing analytics in a comprehensive and understandable way.
  • Support commercial analysis across key Q-commerce levers, including ads monetization, margin analysis, and rebate structures.
  • Track performance of the category - including sales, pricing, promotions, and availability - and proactively flag risks or opportunities to the Category Manager.
  • Support the preparation of periodic business reviews with key suppliers, including data packs, performance summaries, and recommendations.
  • Collaborate with category, supply chain, and content teams to ensure data-driven decision-making across assortment, pricing, and promotions.

What You'll Need

  • 1–2 years of experience in an analytical, commercial, or category role, preferably within retail, quick commerce, or e-commerce.
  • Strong analytical skills with a proven ability to analyse large volumes of data and distil them into clear insights and recommended steps forward.
  • Hands-on experience writing SQL queries; ability to build and run queries on Insights (or similar BI/reporting tools).
  • Experience automating reports and building dashboards for day-on-day performance analysis; ability to create easy-to-use, intuitive dashboards for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong storytelling and presentation skills - able to build creative, polished decks for supplier performance meetings and senior management, on both an ad-hoc and regular basis.
  • Solid understanding of the Q-commerce business model, including ads monetization, margin analysis, and rebate structures.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets; familiarity with data visualization and reporting tools is a strong plus.
  • Strong understanding of commercial KPIs and category performance metrics.
  • Detail-oriented with solid organizational and time management abilities.
  • A proactive attitude, willingness to learn, and the ability to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

What we’ll provide you

We offer colleagues the opportunity to drive impact in the region while they learn and grow. As a full time Careem colleague, you will be able to:

  • Work and learn from great minds by joining a community of inspiring colleagues.
  • Put your passion to work in a purposeful organisation dedicated to creating impact in a region with a lot of untapped potential.
  • Explore new opportunities to learn and grow every day.
  • Work 4 days a week in office & 1 day from home, and remotely from any country in the world for 30 days a year with unlimited vacation days per year. (If you are in an individual contributor role in tech, you will have 2 office days a week and 3 to work from home.)
  • Access to healthcare benefits and fitness reimbursements for health activities including gym, health club, and training classes.

We are seeking a high-performing Instructional Systems Designer (ISD) to support the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) Corporate University (CU) Course Maintenance Program. This position is contingent on contract award. Work Schedule and Location Employment Status: Full-Time Location: Remote within the U.S., with anticipated travel to the FDIC Dallas Regional Office (Dallas, TX) approximately once per quarter Who You Are & What You’ll Do As an Instructional Systems Designer (ISD) supporting the FDIC Corporate University Course Maintenance Program, you will serve in a Key Personnel capacity responsible for maintaining, revising, and modernizing a comprehensive catalog of professional courses and training collateral. You will work in close collaboration with FDIC Corporate University personnel, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), and technical monitors to update existing courseware across all instructional delivery formats. In this role, you will analyze source documentation, review Course Change Sheets, and update learning products across Instructor-Led Training (ILT), Virtual Instructor-Led Training (VILT), Web-Based Training (WBT), Instructional Video, and electronic Job Aids. You will ensure all updated and converted training assets align with Corporate University design standards, templates, style guides, and Section 508 accessibility requirements. Key responsibilities include: Collaborating closely with FDIC CU personnel, project managers, and SMEs to design, update, and maintain courseware. Updating and revising instructional materials across multiple modalities, including design plans, instructor guides, participant guides, slide decks, case studies, and virtual classroom setups. Reviewing Course Change Sheets and updating content to reflect regulatory, technical, or procedural changes. Developing asynchronous Web-Based Training (WBT) using approved templates and authoring tools (such as Lectora). Creating, scripting, and captioning instructional multimedia, including video files developed in Camtasia (with separate SRT or VTT caption files). Developing and updating electronic performance support tools and job aids in MS Word and PDF formats. Ensuring all deliverables comply with CU technical guidelines, template specifications, and Section 508 accessibility standards. Routing completed deliverables through quality assurance reviews and uploading finalized products to FDIC systems of record and LMS repositories. What You Bring to the Table - Requirements Education: Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in Education, Instructional Design, or a related subject. Experience: Minimum of five (5) years of professional field instructional design experience (excluding time in school). Accessibility Training / Certification: DHS Trusted Tester trained or certified (preferred or able to meet program testing requirements). Demonstrated Functional Experience: Proven, hands-on experience across all of the following core competencies: Technical writing and editing for professional and regulatory audiences. Converting existing and legacy course materials into modern instructional formats. Web-based course development and instructional authoring tools. Multimedia technology integration and visual design. Required Software & Technology Skills: Microsoft Word: Advanced proficiency, including table formatting, custom styles, headers/footers, table of contents creation and updates, page and section breaks, field codes, and working with macros. Microsoft PowerPoint: Advanced proficiency, including slide masters, custom layouts, placeholders, layering, graphic manipulation, and macros. Microsoft Excel: High proficiency in data entry, formatting, sorting, and filtering. Desirable Software & Technology Skills: Lectora Inspire / Lectora Desktop (version 21 or equivalent) Camtasia (video production and closed captioning) Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) Adobe Connect and Microsoft Teams (virtual training and classroom management) DHS Trusted Tester Section 508 conformance testing processes Why Join Team Carney ? When you join Team Carney , you join a legacy of excellence. We focus on our people because when we make a positive impact on the lives of our employees, they are able to make a positive impact on our clients. We offer a full suite of competitive benefits, including: Health & Wellness: Multiple medical, dental, and vision insurance options (BCBS CareFirst), health spending accounts (HSA), and flexible spending accounts (FSA). Financial Security: 401(k) retirement plan with company match, plus Carney-paid life and disability insurance. Work-Life Harmony: Generous Paid Time Off (PTO), 11 paid holidays, and 6 weeks of paid parental leave. Professional & Personal Growth: Annual tuition assistance (up to $5,000) and student loan repayment. Get Out and Learn: Up to $200 annually to learn almost anything (from pottery to coding!). Get Out and Run: Up to $200 annually to participate in fitness and active lifestyle events. Continuous Development: Ad hoc training and ongoing professional development access. title: Medium Voltage Electrician (Construction)
description:
SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge. Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are hiring Medium Voltage Electricians to join SpaceXAI’s internal construction team supporting the rapid build-out of our data centers. This is a traveling role — you will mobilize with project teams to active construction sites, install and commission medium-voltage systems at 12.47 kV, 13.8 kV, and 34.5 kV, and move with the work as new facilities come online.

You will install e-house medium-voltage switchgear (MVSG), generator step-up transformers (GSUs), 15 kV and 35 kV cable, and duct bank; support hipot/VLF testing; and work adjacent to live campus buses. This is a construction and commissioning role: build new medium-voltage infrastructure from drawings and turn it over. It is not a facilities-maintenance or operating-plant role.

This is an hourly position with overtime. Expect 80% or more travel on a rotation, with per diem.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Travel with internal construction and electrical teams to project sites to install, terminate, and test medium-voltage systems, including e-house medium-voltage switchgear (MVSG), generator step-up transformers (GSUs), 15 kV and 35 kV cable, duct bank, and associated control wiring.
  • Pull, rack, land, and terminate 15 kV and 35 kV cable using manufacturer-approved stress cones and terminations.
  • Install medium-voltage duct bank, manholes, and raceway for 12.47 kV, 13.8 kV, and 34.5 kV circuits.
  • Support hipot/VLF and insulation-resistance testing of new medium-voltage cable and gear: prepare, isolate, ground, and stand the work with commissioning.
  • Work adjacent to live campus medium-voltage buses under switching orders, clearances, and LOTO.
  • Read and interpret medium-voltage one-lines, physical drawings, cable schedules, and termination drawings; produce as-builts and test records.
  • Ensure compliance with NEC, NFPA 70E, OSHA 1910.269, and SpaceXAI safety and quality standards, including switching, clearance, LOTO, and arc-flash protocols.
  • Collaborate with contractors, engineers, and operations teams to deliver projects on time with zero incidents.
  • Participate in constructability reviews and provide field feedback to improve designs.
  • Mobilize quickly between project locations as construction phases and priorities shift.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 5+ years of hands-on electrical construction at 5 kV and above in industrial, data center, utility, or generation environments. Experience at 480 V does not meet this requirement.
  • Documented 15 kV and/or 35 kV terminations (termination logs, QC packages, or manufacturer terminator qualification cards).
  • Experience installing or landing medium-voltage switchgear, transformers/GSUs, and medium-voltage cable at 12.47 kV, 13.8 kV, and/or 34.5 kV.
  • Ability to read medium-voltage one-lines, cable schedules, and termination drawings.
  • Working knowledge of NFPA 70E, lockout/tagout (LOTO), medium-voltage switching and clearance, and OSHA 1910.269.
  • Ability to lift 50+ lbs, climb ladders, and work in e-houses, duct banks, and industrial environments with PPE.
  • Hourly position with overtime; willingness to work nights, weekends, and extended shifts during construction and energization.
  • Ability and willingness to travel 80% or more on a construction rotation; per diem and/or housing provided while on site.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Manufacturer terminator qualification cards for 15 kV and/or 35 kV.
  • State journeyman electrician license, or lineman/substation qualification, with the ability to work in Tennessee and Mississippi.
  • Data center or industrial campus medium-voltage construction experience, including e-house MVSG, duct bank, and work adjacent to live 15/35 kV buses.
  • Switching and clearance experience on 15 kV or 35 kV systems under OSHA 1910.269.
  • OSHA 30 or equivalent construction safety training in addition to NFPA 70E and OSHA 1910.269.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Schedule varies depending on site operational needs; frequent overtime and weekend support is required.
  • Ability to perform job duties that require standing, kneeling, crouching, twisting upper body, working in cramped positions, climbing, lifting up to 50 lbs., and working on ladders/lifts at elevated heights.
  • Ability to work in an environment requiring exposure to fumes, odors, noise, heat, cold, and rain.
  • Ability to rapidly change roles/responsibilities while working in a high-paced, challenging work environment.
  • Stand: up to 6 hours per day.
  • Sit: up to 3 hours per day.
  • Push/Pull: up to 75 lbs. (unassisted) 1–2 hours per day.
  • Overhead reach: up to 3 hours per day.
  • Walk: up to 3 hours per day.
  • Lift/Carry: up to 50 lbs. (unassisted) 1–2 hours per day.

SpaceXAI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our Recruitment Privacy Notice.
